column1: # FEX ASM expectations that x86 hardware contradicts and that upstream's
# Known_Failures_host does not name. The campaign runs each of these tests
# and reports its result, but sets it aside from the pass rate under the
# policy, as it does upstream's known failures on native hosts. Each row
# gives the test as the campaign names it, what FEX expects, and the native
# Intel evidence for what x86 does instead. A row that names no test of the

column3: expectation
column4: evidence

column3: VSTMXCSR after VLDMXCSR of 0xffff reads 0xffc0: FEX drops the exception flags, DAZ and the reserved bits
column4: Xeon Platinum 8581C (CPUID 1 EAX 0x000c06f2): VLDMXCSR and LDMXCSR of 0xffff read back 0xffff; repository case sse-mxcsr-keeps-exception-flags.s holds the flags on the same host; upstream disables the test on native hosts (Disabled_Tests_host)

column3: MOV ES, SS and DS of 0x4142, 0x4143 and 0x4144 load and read back: FEX validates no selector
column4: Xeon Platinum 8581C (CPUID 1 EAX 0x000c06f2), Linux 6.12: each load raises #GP with error 0x4140, 0x4140 and 0x4144 (beyond the GDT; an LDT selector with no LDT); upstream disables the test on native hosts (Disabled_Tests_host)

column3: REX.R MOV ES, SS and DS of 0x4142, 0x4143 and 0x4144 load and read back: FEX validates no selector
